figuraperf.config.title: Figura Performance
figuraperf.config.reset.tooltip: Puts every setting back the way it shipped.
figuraperf.config.no_cloth: Install Cloth Config for the full settings screen
figuraperf.option.enabled.tooltip: Turns the whole mod off, leaving Figura exactly as it was.
figuraperf.option.always_full_self.toolt: Your own avatar keeps everything, whatever the limits say.
figuraperf.option.profile.tooltip: Which set of limits to use. Automatic switches to the crowd profile once enough people are around.
figuraperf.option.crowd_players.tooltip: How many players nearby before the crowd profile takes over. The switch waits two seconds and leaves later than it enters, so one passer-by cannot flip it.
figuraperf.option.crowd_radius.tooltip: How far to look when counting the people around you.
figuraperf.option.full_distance.tooltip: Past this distance an avatar keeps its model but loses scripts and animations.
figuraperf.option.model_distance.tooltip: Past this distance the avatar is not drawn at all and the player falls back to their skin.
figuraperf.option.max_full.tooltip: Only this many of the nearest avatars get scripts and animations.
figuraperf.option.max_model.tooltip: Only this many of the nearest avatars are drawn at all.
figuraperf.option.animation_interval.too: How often cut down avatars run their animations. 1 means every frame.
figuraperf.option.script_interval.toolti: How often cut down avatars tick their scripts. 1 means every tick.
figuraperf.option.complexity_lod.tooltip: Instead of dropping a distant avatar, hand Figura a smaller complexity budget and let it trim itself. The avatar loses parts rather than disappearing.
figuraperf.option.complexity_floor.toolt: How much of its complexity an avatar keeps at the furthest distance it is still drawn at.
figuraperf.option.skip_offscreen.tooltip: Figura keeps ticking and animating avatars behind you. This stops that. Turn around and they pick up again within a tick.
figuraperf.option.texture_uploads.toolti: Spreads avatar texture uploads over frames to smooth the hitch when a crowd loads. 0 removes the limit.
figuraperf.option.skip_shadow.tooltip: With a shader pack the world is drawn again for the shadow map. Avatars there are rarely worth the cost.
figuraperf.option.skip_paperdoll: No avatar in the paper doll
figuraperf.option.skip_paperdoll.tooltip: The doll in the corner is a second full render of your own avatar, every frame.
figuraperf.option.adaptive.tooltip: Tightens the limits on its own when the frame rate falls below the target, and relaxes them once it recovers.
figuraperf.option.target_fps.tooltip: The frame rate adaptive mode tries to hold.
figuraperf.option.adaptive_floor.tooltip: Adaptive mode always leaves at least this many full avatars.
figuraperf.option.auto_block.tooltip: Switches off any avatar costing more than the limit below. Off by default: turning someone's avatar off unasked is a strong thing to do.
figuraperf.option.auto_block_millis.tool: An avatar costing more than this per frame is switched off. Blocks are forgotten when the game restarts.
figuraperf.option.auto_block_announce.to: Prints a line naming the avatar that was switched off and what it cost.
figuraperf.option.whitelist.tooltip: Names separated by commas. These avatars keep everything, whatever the distance and the limits say.
figuraperf.option.blocked_list.tooltip: Names separated by commas. Their avatars are never drawn for you.
figuraperf.option.overlay.tooltip: Shows the frame rate, what the budget is doing, and which avatars cost the most, scripts and geometry apart.
figuraperf.option.overlay_rows.tooltip: How many avatars the overlay lists.
figuraperf.option.overlay_offset.tooltip: Pixels to push the overlay down by, to clear a frame counter drawn by another mod.
figuraperf.hud.title: Figura Performance
figuraperf.hud.cost: that is %s%% of the frame, about %s fps
figuraperf.message.autoblocked: Avatar of %s switched off, it was costing %s ms a frame
key.figuraperf.toggle: Turn the mod on or off
key.figuraperf.block: Block the avatar you look at
